research_question: Is the pricing-aware teacher's instability caused by estimating its SDF scale and Euler moments on short 24-month minibatches?
pricing_penalty_source: Frozen from P1-G1-V004; no penalty retuning is allowed.
validation_selection_rule: Using 2000-2009 only, retain candidates with factor Sharpe at least 1.5 and select the lowest combined-74 ridge HJ distance; break ties by lower mean absolute alpha, then the shorter window.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019, the selected window must improve combined-74 ridge HJ and mean absolute alpha by at least five percent relative to the validation-selected FF5-plus-momentum baseline while retaining factor Sharpe above that baseline.
boundary: This pilot changes only the month window. It does not authorize a new five-seed run unless the development promotion rule is met, and it never opens the sealed period.
